hero.title: Sell Your Way. No Restrictions.
hero.description: Every fashion business is different—and Qlozet is built to support that. Whether you sell ready-made pieces, custom designs, or both, you have full control over how you operate.
hero.closing: Flexible selling, designed for real fashion businesses.

sections.title: One Platform. Many Ways to Sell.
sections.description: Qlozet supports different types of fashion businesses—so you’re never forced into a single model.
sections.closing: Adapt your business to your strengths.

sections.title: Define How Customers Customize
sections.description: Choose exactly what parts of your designs customers can modify.
features: Control style options (neckline, sleeves, fit, length)
sections.closing: You stay in control of your designs.

sections.title: Price Based on Value, Not Limits
sections.description: Set pricing that reflects your work and complexity.
features: Include rush fees or complexity charges

sections.title: Work With What You Have—or Expand
sections.description: Qlozet allows flexible sourcing and collaboration.
sections.closing: No limitations on how you create.

sections.title: Control Your Workflow
sections.description: Decide how orders come to you.
features: Option for bidding or quoting (if enabled)
sections.closing: You choose how you work—not the platform.

sections.title: Built Around You
sections.description: Whether you’re a solo tailor, a growing brand, or a large workshop—Qlozet adapts to your workflow.
features: Works for small and large-scale vendors
sections.closing: Grow without changing how you operate.

sections.title: Start Simple. Expand Easily.
sections.description: You don’t need everything at once—Qlozet grows with you.
features: Expand your offerings as you grow

sections.title: Flexible—but Still Simple
sections.description: Despite all the options, Qlozet keeps everything easy to manage.

closing.title: Your Business. Your Rules. Your Growth.
closing.description: Qlozet gives you the flexibility to run your fashion business exactly how you want—without compromise.
